# Insert

Inserts a value into an array at a given position.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Insert(items, index, value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to insert into, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |
| `index` | number | The position the value takes, counted from 0. A whole number from 0 to the length of items; the length itself adds the value at the end. A negative, fractional or larger number, or null, is a runtime error. |
| `value` | any | The value to insert, of any type, null included. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding the elements of items with value placed at index, the elements from index onward each moved one position later. Never null.

## Example

`Insert([1, 3], 1, 2)` returns `[1, 2, 3]`.
